phases.title: Cation Placement and Electrochemical Interface Builder

tasks.title: Create cation placement backend
tasks.description: New endpoint in server/routers/cation.py or extend water_layer.py. Two modes: near-surface (coordinated with adsorbate, 2.5-4.0 Å) and bulk-water (>6 Å from surface, replace water molecule).

tasks.description: MCP tool in server/mcp_tools/tools/structure.py for cation placement

tasks.description: Frontend tool in src/lib/chat/structure-tools.ts

tasks.title: Electrochemical interface builder pipeline
tasks.description: Orchestration logic chaining: slab_gen -> adsorbate_place -> water_layer -> place_cation. Can be a CatBot compound tool or workflow template.

tasks.title: Create slow-growth workflow node definition
tasks.description: New DAG node type in src/lib/workflow/node-defs/calculation/slow-growth.ts. Parameters: NSW, POTIM, SMASS, TEBEG, INCREM, iconst_content. Separate from md.ts due to fundamentally different inputs (ICONST) and outputs (REPORT).

tasks.title: Add constant-potential parameter group
tasks.description: Shared param_schema group for TPOT and CP-VASP parameters. Importable by both md.ts and slow-growth.ts. Uses show_if conditionals.

tasks.title: Register slow-growth node in node index
tasks.description: Add slow_growth to src/lib/workflow/node-defs/calculation/index.ts and src/lib/workflow/node-defs/index.ts

tasks.title: Add backend dispatch handler for slow-growth node
tasks.description: Server-side dispatch in server/workflow/ that calls generate_vasp_inputs() with calculation_type=SLOW_GROWTH and constant_potential setting

tasks.title: Create workflow template: electrochemical-slow-growth
tasks.description: Pre-built template: structure_input -> geo_opt -> md(equilibration) -> slow_growth(constant-potential). Registered in server/workflow/presets/

tasks.title: Add REPORT auto-parsing after slow-growth completion
tasks.description: When slow-growth job completes on HPC, workflow engine calls parse_report() on REPORT file and stores barrier analysis as step results

phases.title: AI Research Planner — CatBot High-Level Planning

tasks.title: Create research planner backend
tasks.description: New module server/utils/research_planner.py that takes a research goal description and returns structured computation plan. Calls cn_coupling network, generates cation condition matrix, estimates compute cost.

tasks.title: Add CatBot MCP tool: plan_research_project
tasks.description: High-level tool that decomposes research goal -> computation plan. Returns path x condition matrix with cost estimates.

tasks.title: Add CatBot MCP tool: create_batch_workflows
tasks.description: Tool that creates multiple workflows under a single project from the computation matrix. Server-side loop to minimize tool calls.

tasks.description: Frontend tool definitions in workflow-tools.ts for Anthropic-direct mode

tasks.description: Endpoint that collects barrier data from multiple completed workflows and computes delta_delta_G (cation effect) for each path and condition.

tasks.description: Tool that generates comparison table/plot from completed workflow set
